knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A task is assigned only when the training, sign-off and operator instruction are in place. A certificate alone is not authority.
A CHECKED entry needs a source and a date. Without them it is not accepted as checked.
Chemicals are separated by type, locked and kept away from fuel and people. The Australian rules must be checked.

practicalCriteria: Operating process names the person and the record for each step
Task and training matrix shows who may do each task, and the supervision in place
Equipment register shows maintenance and chemical storage
Compliance register entries each show a source, a date and a status
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Operating process chart and task matrix
stopWorkCriteria: Restricted task assigned to an untrained or unlicensed worker
Compliance entry shown as CHECKED with no source
Chemicals stored with fuel or in the cabin
